in_arabic.name: شاهد
in_arabic.meaning: الشاهد هو الذي يرى و يشهد على شيء ما
in_arabic.long_meaning: الشاهد هو الذي يرى و يشهد على شيء ما، و هو من الأسماء التي وردت في القرآن الكريم، و يعني الشخص الذي يكون شاهدا على شيء ما، و هو اسم مشتق من الفعل 'شهد' الذي يعني 'رأى' أو 'شهد'.

in_urdu.name: شاہد
in_urdu.meaning: شاہد کا مطلب ہے گواہ یا تشہاد
in_urdu.long_meaning: شاہد ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے گواہ یا تشہاد، یہ نام قرآن مجید میں بھی آیا ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو کسی چیز کا گواہ ہوتا ہے، یہ نام عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے، اور اسلامی تقالید میں اس کا بڑا دینی اور ثقافتی اہمیت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: शाहिद
in_hindi.meaning: शाहिद का अर्थ है गवाह या साक्षी
in_hindi.long_meaning: शाहिद एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है गवाह या साक्षी, यह नाम कुरआन में भी आया है, और इसका अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जो किसी चीज़ का गवाह होता है, यह नाम अरबी मूल से लिया गया है, और भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इसकी महत्वपूर्ण सांस्कृतिक और धार्मिक महत्व है।

data.cultural_impact: The term Shaahid holds immense cultural significance in the Islamic world as it refers to a martyr - someone who sacrifices their life in the name of Islam, in defense of their community, or in the pursuit of justice. Shaahids are often honored and celebrated as heroes, who sacrificed their lives not only for themselves but for the greater good of their faith, community, and humanity as a whole. Their sacrifices are commemorated and remembered through various religious and cultural practices, including the erection of martyrs' monuments and the recitation of special prayers for their souls.
data.spiritual_significance: The term Shaahid also holds deep spiritual significance as it reminds us of the importance of bearing witness to truth in our daily lives. In Islamic teachings, truth, or Haqq, is considered a fundamental pillar of our faith, and striving for it in both our inner and outer worlds is an essential part of our spiritual journey. The Shaahid embodies this spiritual principle by sacrificing their life to stand for truth and justice, inspiring us to live our lives with sincerity and conviction. Furthermore, the belief in witnessing in the Hereafter also holds symbolic significance as it implies that the truth shall ultimately prevail, and that each soul will be held accountable for their deeds and beliefs. Consequently, the term Shaahid serves as a powerful reminder to remain steadfast in our faith and to strive for truth and justice, even in the face of adversity.
